fr.sorbonne_u.cps.pubsub.interfaces

Interface MessageFilterI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.io.Serializable

    public interface MessageFilterI
extends java.io.Serializable
    The interface MessageFilterI declares the signatures of methods to be implemented by message filters in the publication/subscription system.

    Description

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2026-01-20

    Author:
